headline: A 2022 law lets the Department of Veterans Affairs build specified major medical facility projects during fiscal year 2022 and sets a spending cap for each one.
what_it_does: The law gives the Department of Veterans Affairs permission to carry out certain major medical facility projects during fiscal year 2022. It also sets the maximum amount that can be spent on each listed project. The official summary does not name the projects or their locations, so this explanation stays general.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive care at VA medical facilities
who_it_affects.how: The approved projects are meant to change the VA medical facilities these veterans use, though the summary does not describe specific changes.
The department is authorized to start and spend money on the listed projects, up to the set limit for each one.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted October 10, 2022, and covers projects carried out during fiscal year 2022.
